description: This file contains a test base class implementation for media pipeline testing, including setup and teardown methods, media pipeline creation and destruction, and state notification methods.

classes.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
classes.description: A test fixture class providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for media pipeline unit tests.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects for media pipeline testing.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up mock objects after tests.

methods.name: destroyMediaPipeline
methods.description: Destroys the media pipeline object and resets related callbacks.

methods.description: Simulates a change in playback state and notifies the media pipeline callback.

methods.name: setNetworkState
methods.description: Simulates a change in network state and notifies the media pipeline callback.

methods.description: Simulates a media data request from the media pipeline.
